# All Kolorz Custom Paint & Body

> Custom paint and body shop on Belt Boulevard in Southside Richmond, Virginia, in business since 2009. Known for candy paint, color changes and color matching, plus collision and dent repair, custom engine bays, airbrush, lettering, pinstriping, headlight restoration and starlight headliners (in-house custom work by ATB Kustoms). Also co-hosts car shows with Dreamchasers Auto Club RVA.

## Contact
- Name: All Kolorz Custom Paint & Body (also written A.K.C. Paint & Body)
- Address: 232 E Belt Blvd, Richmond, VA 23224 (Southside Richmond)
- Phone (call or text): (804) 647-1222
- Website: https://all-kolorz-custom-paint-body.netlify.app/
- Quote form: https://all-kolorz-custom-paint-body.netlify.app/quote.html

## Hours
- Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Saturday and Sunday: Closed

## Services
- Custom paint and candy: color changes, candy coats, candy over carbon fiber, lace and flake finishes
- Collision and dent repair, panel refinishing, truck and SUV body work
- Color-matched parts: paint-matched mirrors, custom color-matched emblems, script emblems, painted brake calipers
- Custom engine bays: painted engine covers, strut bars, color correction
- Airbrush, custom lettering and pinstriping (vehicles, motorcycle tanks, skateboards, trophies)
- Headlight (headlamp) restoration
- Motorcycle fairings, tanks and side covers
- Starlight headliners by ATB Kustoms (fiber optic, hidden wiring, color and brightness control)

## Prices
- Paint and body work: quoted per job. Text photos plus year, make and model to (804) 647-1222.
- ATB Kustoms starlight headliners (starting prices; vary by vehicle type): 250 stars from $250; 350 from $300; 450 from $350; 550 from $450; 650 from $550; 750 from $600; 850 from $700; 900 from $750; 1,000 from $800; 1,100 from $850; 1,200 from $900; over 1,200 priced per vehicle.

## How to book
Text photos to (804) 647-1222, call, DM @all_kolorz_ on Instagram, or use https://all-kolorz-custom-paint-body.netlify.app/quote.html.

## FAQ
- Where are you? 232 E Belt Blvd, Richmond, VA 23224, on Belt Boulevard in Southside Richmond.
- Hours? Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM; closed weekends.
- How do I get a quote? Text photos and your vehicle details to (804) 647-1222 or use the quote form.
- Can you match factory paint? Yes; color matching of mirrors, emblems and panels is what the shop is known for.
- Do you work on trucks, SUVs and motorcycles? Yes.
- How much is a starlight headliner? From $250 for 250 stars up to $900 for 1,200 stars; varies by vehicle.
